sentences.text: Céline Marie Claudette Dion , -LRB- -LSB- ˈdiːɒn -RSB- -LSB- seˈlɪn dziˈjɔ̃ -RSB- ; born 30 March 1968 -RRB- is a Canadian singer and businesswoman .	Canadian	Canadian people

Born into a large family from Charlemagne , Quebec , Dion emerged as a teen star in the French-speaking world after her manager and future husband René Angélil mortgaged his home to finance her first record .	René Angélil	René Angélil

Dion first gained international recognition in the 1980s by winning both the 1982 Yamaha World Popular Song Festival and the 1988 Eurovision Song Contest where she represented Switzerland .	Yamaha	Yamaha (manufacturer)	World Popular Song Festival	World Popular Song Festival	1988 Eurovision Song Contest	Eurovision Song Contest 1988	represented Switzerland	Switzerland in the Eurovision Song Contest 1988
Following a series of French albums during the 1980s , she signed on to Epic Records in the United States .	Epic	Epic Records	Epic Records	Epic Records

In 1990 , Dion released her debut English-language album , Unison , establishing herself as a viable pop artist in North America and other English-speaking areas of the world .	Unison	Unison (Celine Dion album)
During the 1990s , with the help of Angélil , she achieved worldwide fame after releasing several English albums along with additional French albums .

Her albums , Falling into You -LRB- 1996 -RRB- and Let 's Talk About Love -LRB- 1997 -RRB- , were both certified diamond in the US while D'eux -LRB- 1995 -RRB- became the best-selling French-language album of all time .	Falling into You	Falling into You	diamond	RIAA certification#RIAA Diamond certifications	D'eux	D'eux

She also scored a series of international number-one hits , including `` Nothing Broken but My Heart '' , `` The Power of Love '' , `` Think Twice '' , `` Because You Loved Me '' , `` It 's All Coming Back to Me Now '' , `` My Heart Will Go On '' , and `` I 'm Your Angel . ''	Nothing Broken but My Heart	Nothing Broken but My Heart	The Power of Love	The Power of Love (Jennifer Rush song)#Celine Dion version	Think Twice	Think Twice (Celine Dion song)	Because You Loved Me	Because You Loved Me	My Heart Will Go On	My Heart Will Go On
However , in 1999 at the height of her success , Dion announced a hiatus from entertainment to start a family and spend time with her husband , who had been diagnosed with cancer .

She returned to the top of pop music in 2002 and signed to perform nightly in A New Day ... -LRB- 2003 -- 07 -RRB- , a five-star theatrical show at the Colosseum at Caesars Palace , on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise , Nevada .	the Colosseum	The Colosseum at Caesars Palace	Caesars Palace	Caesars Palace
It became the most successful residency show of all time , grossing US $ 385 million .	residency show	residency show
Dion 's music has been influenced by genres ranging from rock and R&B to gospel and classical .	R&B	Rhythm and blues	gospel	Gospel music	classical	European classical music
Her recordings are mainly in French and English , although she also sings in Spanish , Italian , German , Latin , Japanese , and Mandarin Chinese .
While her releases have often received mixed critical reception , she is regarded as one of pop music 's most influential voices .

Dion has won five Grammy Awards , including Album of the Year and Record of the Year .	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards	Album of the Year	Grammy Award for Album of the Year	Record of the Year	Grammy Award for Record of the Year
She is the second best-selling female artist in the US during the Nielsen SoundScan era .	Nielsen SoundScan	Nielsen SoundScan

In 2003 , Dion was honoured by the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry -LRB- IFPI -RRB- for selling over 50 million albums in Europe .	International Federation of the Phonographic Industry	International Federation of the Phonographic Industry

Dion remains the best-selling Canadian artist and one of the best-selling artists of all time with record sales of over 200 million copies worldwide .	Canadian	Canadian people	one of the best-selling artists of all time	List of best-selling music artists
